name: Theatre Porto "Family Hangout"
description: Start your Saturday with a free and engaging morning activity open to all ages at this welcoming creative space.
longDescription:
The Theatre Porto "Family Hangout" is a free morning activity hosted by Theatre Porto, a creative space dedicated to engaging audiences of all ages. This event is designed as a welcoming opportunity for families and individuals to participate in creative activities within a supportive environment. It aims to foster community engagement and provide accessible artistic experiences.

Attendees can expect a relaxed and inclusive atmosphere, suitable for a diverse audience including families with children, teenagers, and adults. The event runs for a duration of approximately two hours, from 10:00 to 12:00. The activities are designed to be engaging for various age groups, encouraging participation and interaction. Theatre Porto operates as a dedicated creative venue, providing a suitable setting for artistic exploration.

Admission to the "Family Hangout" is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The event takes place at Theatre Porto, which is located a 5-minute walk from Trindade metro station, served by multiple lines. The venue is designed to be family-friendly, offering an accessible environment for all attendees.
